notes: Flagged unit la + [ha] + yom → daily accounted morpheme by morpheme: yom carries the lexeme, the לְ the distributive relation and the assimilated article the definiteness the idiom writes; the single English word carries all three, so rule 30's condition is met and the group is retained, headed on the noun. Splitting the article off as unrepresented would contradict rule 22's closing sentence, and splitting as in v. 3's day by day fails because the ASV writes one word here.

for seven days takes its supplied for on the numeral opening the phrase (rule 33), and the two supplied the's of the food of the offering made by fire go to the nominals they determine, no article morpheme standing in the chain.
